name: Akagi (carrier conversion)
axes: right-handed: X longitudinal/bow-positive; Y up; Z transverse
dimensionBasis: Existing recognition drawing dimensions (see its measurement caveats)

reference.configuration: Akagi original 1927–30 carrier conversion: three flight-deck levels, no island, short upper deck with a slight aft slope, two pole masts and the distinctive starboard two-level uptake with a large downturned funnel and smaller upward outlet. Two twin 200 mm turrets forward and six single aft casemate guns; only near-side mounts visible. This original profile is not the post-1938 full-flight-deck/island conversion.
